Messages.Body:
Came across a new situation that requires clarification.

Player 1 has Ozmo out with Pulse of Canaille on him.

Player 2 plays Malkavian Dementia and steals Ozmo.

Player 3 takes out Player 1.

The question that comes out of this: Does Player 2 get to keep Ozmo
upon his Untap or does he give it back to Player 1, who is now out.

We debated the question and decided that Ozmo would be lost at the
Untap phase as per the card, regardless of the fact that there was no
player to whom Ozmo would be returned.

Thanks

Mike Eichler
Prince of Ramstein

> Untap phase as per the card, regardless of the fact that there was no

Correct:

Controlled Cards

* If control of a card is returned to a player who has been ousted, the
card is burned. [RTR 19950905]
